brief:
Hakeem Jeffries, nominated to lead House Democrats, has received substantial campaign funding from pro-Israel donors and previously declared "Israel today, Israel tomorrow, Israel forever," the Electronic Intifada reported. His voting record and public statements reflect consistent support for Israeli military operations, according to the outlet's analysis of his political contributions and rhetoric.

The nomination comes as House Democrats prepare for the new Congress. Jeffries' funding sources and stated positions on Middle East policy have drawn scrutiny from Palestinian advocacy groups monitoring lawmakers' records on Gaza.
dek: Hakeem Jeffries once declared: “Israel today, Israel tomorrow, Israel forever.”
title: Newly nominated House Speaker backed Gaza operations, records show
